title: Withering Murkglider
summary: Withering Murkglider releases parasites repeatedly as its health falls.
overview: Withering Murkglider releases parasites repeatedly as its health falls.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Expect three parasitic murkgliders at 99%, 79%, 59%, 39% and 19%.
Control the parasites before pushing through another threshold.
A disengagement fully heals the boss and rearms the sequence.
